title: Straza DPoP proof (v1beta1)
description: The decoded DPoP proof (RFC 9449) a key holder sends in the DPoP request header: the protected header and the claims of the compact JWS. Added 2026-10-20. The schema pins the shape. The verifier also checks what a schema cannot: the signature, the nonce window, the htu match, ath against the token and the spent jti (SPEC.md, Key-bound tokens). Other members of a document that carries a proof are not constrained here.

jwk.description: The public key that signed the proof. It never carries the private part d.

htu.description: The absolute request URL. Query and fragment are ignored.

iat.description: Required and informational. The nonce carries freshness.

jti.description: The proof id, spent per replica for three minutes. At most 128 bytes.

nonce.description: The latest DPoP-Nonce the server sent.

ath.description: Unpadded base64url SHA-256 of the access token. Present exactly when the request carries a session token.

ctr.description: The counter of a key check-in, equal to the counter in the body. Present exactly on a key check-in proof. Added 2026-10-20.
